name: US Wire & Cable Corporation
old_description: True to its name, since 1985 U.S. Wire & Cable Corporation has produced cable and extension cords right here on American soil. This brings an unparalleled sense of pride and commitment to American ingenuity, quality and service.
about:
U.S. Wire & Cable Corporation has been producing cable and extension cords in Newark, New Jersey since 1985. The business traces its roots to 1956 when Alex Folkman founded Flexon Industries on the pillars of quality, service, and family values. Today the corporation remains family-owned and operated under the leadership of Chairman Joseph Folkman, President Warren Swindlehurst, and Vice President David Rauch.

The company operates three U.S. manufacturing facilities and six distribution centers, supplemented by offshore production. Its four divisions — Flexon Industries, Winzeler Couplings & Metals, U.S. Wire & Cable, and Voltec Power & Lighting — manufacture garden hoses, precision metal stampings and ferrules, power cords, extension cords, task lighting, and power distribution systems. Product lines include indoor household cords, appliance cords, cold-weather and oil-resistant extension cords, cord management accessories, and GFCI devices.

Customers span retail partners, distributors, and consumers across the lawn-and-garden, electrical, construction, and automotive channels. Flexon serves professional and home lawn care; Voltec targets electrical and construction markets; Winzeler supplies precision metal components to automotive and other industries.

The founder’s original vision — quality, service, and family values — continues to drive the business. The company emphasizes domestic manufacturing, a customer-first mindset with U.S.-based service representatives, and a commitment to consistent quality and innovation across all divisions.
